## Design

### 2026-10-01 — I've currently designed the shell that will protect the battle bot. It uses a flat box 8 inches by 6 inches  for the main section with an angled front that will allow other bots to ronn up on it when

**0.5h**

I've currently designed the shell that will protect the battle bot. It uses a flat box 8 inches by 6 inches  for the main section with an angled front that will allow other bots to ronn up on it when it flips. I've also begen making the base that will hold my elctronics and main weapon.

### 2026-10-04 — I have added screws that screw together the top and bottom for easy acces they willl be the screws in the supply list. I have now started making the wukong board as well as making the servos accurate.

**3.5h**

I have added screws that screw together the top and bottom for easy acces they willl be the screws in the supply list. I have now started making the wukong board as well as making the servos accurate. I have also begin working on making herring bone gear aswell as researching them.
